 Archrivals India and Pakistan face off in the final of the 2026 SAFF Championship, contested by teams in the South Asian Football Federation.
 The match at Bangabandhu National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh, will kick off at 8pm local time (14:00 GMT).
